high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "richertoday." The post is part of a series, as indicated by the "2/9" in the top right corner, suggesting there are nine parts to this series. Text Content: The post highlights a comparison between Airtel and Jio in terms of active user additions in June 2021. It states that Airtel added 24.3 Lakh (Lakh is a unit equivalent to 100,000) active users, surpassing Jio
